messages.text: I’ve proposed a refund of **BRL 93.50** for the leather crossbody bag. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a message in chat won’t confirm it. The refund amount is based on what you paid for the item (refund-policy/v2/amount).

The customer confirmed request prop-2f18b60d428a4567, but a staff member rejected it, so nothing will be paid. The staff member gave this reason for the customer: "The returned bag has a stain on the strap."

messages.text: The staff member rejected the refund request because the returned bag has a stain on the strap. Nothing will be paid.
I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Could I speak to a person?
